evidence.model_evidence: The supplied live_retrieval_evidence contains 50 search result entries across 17 queries targeting German QA/test vacancy sources (arbeitsagentur.de, stepstone.de, adzuna.de, arbeitnow.com, germantechjobs.de, eurotechjobs.de, remotive.com, hitmarker.net). Every returned result is irrelevant: Wikipedia articles, Facebook/YouTube pages, eBay community threads, GitHub repositories, Zhihu Q&A, adult-content sites, and ChatGPT pages. No entry exposes a real job listing, API endpoint, or direct vacancy card for QA/testing roles in Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany-wide remote. Consequently, none of the registry sources can be verified as currently providing direct QA/test vacancy cards based solely on this live retrieval evidence.
